title: Full-sum formula for the quadratic bit
statement: Let $m$ be a nonnegative integer and let $x\in\mathbb{F}_2^m$. The complete quadratic bit of $x$ equals $\sum_{i=0}^{m-1}\sum_{j=0}^{m-1} [i<j]x_i x_j$, where each summand is $x_i x_j$ when $i<j$ and $0$ otherwise, and the sum is in $\mathbb{F}_2$.
